[[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]0.875 (Combatant) |baserange = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]5 |hidden_detection = {{Attr|Hidden|Level 2+}} |lead_detection = N/A |flying_detection = N/A |immune = None |footprint = Unknown }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Punch zombies|Store Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Combatant''' or '''Brawler''' was an unused tower from 2021 that was originally meant to be a starter tower and the replacement for the [[Paintballer]]. It is effectively an early version of the [[Brawler]]. This tower appears to have two names, '''Combatant''' and '''Brawler''', both with slightly different statistics and appearance. The '''Brawler''' was used in the [[Main Lobby]] while the '''Combatant''' was used in matches. To differentiate it from the current [[Brawler]], the tower will be referred to as the '''Combatant''', and anything specific to the '''Brawler''' will be referred to as such. The '''Combatant''' would punch enemies with its fists, dealing damage to them. Its statistics were mostly copied from the [[Gladiator]], with even the ability being carried over, though that most likely did nothing. The '''Combatant''' version specifically also has a sound and particles for crits, suggesting it could or was planned to make crits, though it is unclear if these ever worked. The crit effects are not present on the '''Brawler'''. ==Upgrades==
